description:
def same(x, ^x), do: 1 fails today with "entry dispatch pin has no runtime argument operand" on interp and with artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan carrying the same string on run. Elixir rejects a pin of an unbound name in a head at compile time. Entry plans never bind pins (only guard-helper plans do), so the pin reaches two backends as an unresolved runtime operand and each reports it in its own words.

Fix: a construction-time diagnostic from the entry-dispatch planner when a head pins a name no enclosing scope binds, with a message that names the pin and says a head binds names rather than matching them. Signal: a fixture with an expected.diagnostics sidecar, red on every door today with different text per door.
title: A pin in an ordinary function head fails at the backend instead of at construction
